reason: The hypothesis directly restates the known strategy of adding Al to refractory high-entropy alloys to reduce density, as reported in P33 and P35 for HfNbTaTiZr and TaNbVTi systems, and applies it to the HfMoTaTiZr alloy from P6. The mechanism (solid-solution strengthening, lattice distortion) and predicted outcome (density reduction while retaining strength) are taken from these passages without new integration or mechanistic insight. The proposal is essentially what P6 suggests as future work ('further modification of composition') and what P33 and P35 have already demonstrated in similar alloys.
copied_elements: Partial substitution of Hf with Al to reduce density
Al addition lowers density and can increase specific strength
Maintaining single-phase BCC structure is critical
